system.longDesc: You wield arcane power over machines and mechanisms.
system.requirement: Power talent: Intelligence (Machine Arcana) power focus at Expert

degree0.desc: You gain two Novice-degree Machine Arcana spells.

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree Machine Arcana spell. You also gain the power focus Intelligence (Machine Arcana).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree Machine Arcana spell. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your Machine Arcana spells for –1 SP.
